capabilities: Play a five-zone story campaign with seven shards and a final boss
Fight spawning enemies along a linear path to a boss
Survive arena waves, smash supply crates and choose upgrades
Fight with three weapons against note-themed enemies
Name enemies and gravestones from vault note titles
disambiguation: Not a vault encryption, backup or security tool; it is a first-person shooter game played inside Obsidian.
extras: Desktop only, Obsidian 1.4.0 or newer. Note titles are indexed for enemy names, with folder include/exclude settings and an option to turn the feature off. English and Russian interface. Optional OBSIGAMA sync is off by default and can send run data to Supabase for profiles and leaderboards.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in game, so there is nothing to play inside the app when taking a break from notes.

relations.evidence: If you install the hub and enable the switch in Settings → Hellvault, the game shares run counts

summary: Doom-like first-person shooter game played inside Obsidian, with story, linear path and endless arena modes.
